security.scope: make validate local security targets; no shared SEC acceptance

evidence.result_scope: One complete-history Gitleaks scan, one Trivy source scan, and six immutable-image Trivy scans under the recorded policy; no other gates are represented.

placeholders.${REPOSITORY_ROOT}: Local non-shallow repository containing source_sha and its complete reachable history; clean checkout at source_sha when the archive and images are built.
placeholders.${RESUME_ROOT}/p208-security-bc21516-01: Writable local evidence directory containing source.tar and its extracted source/ snapshot of source_sha.
placeholders.${TOOLS_ROOT}: Local tool directory containing trivy-0.74.0/trivy and writable trivy-cache/. Use the recorded pinned versions.

reproduction.argument_rule: Replace placeholders in each argument string before executing the recorded command array. /repo and /snapshot are fixed container mount destinations, not host paths.
prerequisites: Docker with the recorded immutable images available locally
Python with tarfile filter=data support for archive extraction
reproduction.image_reproduction: The historical scans require the recorded immutable image IDs. A new build may produce different IDs; record and scan those separately instead of attributing this result to them.

gitleaks.rules: Pinned inherited default rules with sixteen exact P205/P207 approved evidence-line observations and nineteen historical fingerprints.
gitleaks.history_scope: All ancestors reachable from source_sha, with no starting cutoff.

report_identifier_classification.classification: Three noncredential pinned-record report identifiers at thirteen exact historical lines.

build_binding.identity_check: Every scanned image ID equals the matching clean-build manifest ID and was independently resolved through docker image inspect by the scan runner before scanning.

prior_classification.classification: Confirmed test-code false positives; lines pass a runtime-generated uuid4().hex idempotency variable and synthetic correlation ID, with no credential literal.
prior_classification.correction: Only .gitleaksignore changed: two exact historical fingerprints, documented owner/reason/scope and review trigger. No broad rule suppression or history rewrite.
prior_classification.prior_evidence: The prior failing record remains separate and has not been relabeled as passing.

additional_verified_digest_exception.classification: Verified non-secret SHA-256 of the exact generated OpenAPI Git blob.
additional_verified_digest_exception.verification: Independently hashed the exact e258f54 generated OpenAPI Git blob; its digest equals the classified evidence value.

additional_verified_policy_label_excepti.classification: Verified non-secret synthetic policy label, not a credential or credential derivative.
additional_verified_policy_label_excepti.verification: Verified the immutable b9 source blob and line143, unchanged historical corrective fixture source, and its committed failed-security record. The abb655e bytes remain intact with one exact appended exception.

evidence.current_commit_note: The nineteen historical fingerprint exceptions retain the original six and add only thirteen exact P206 note/provenance findings classified in the separately retained failed P207 security record. The inherited default rules, nine P205 and seven reviewed P207 approved-line observations are bound to the current tested policy. Current source and full reachable history were scanned again; the prior failed runs remain failures.
limitations: Results reflect the recorded scanner versions and database/policy snapshots; they do not assert absence of all vulnerabilities or future findings.
Trivy excludes lower-severity and unfixed vulnerabilities under HIGH/CRITICAL with ignore-unfixed.
Source scanning excludes development/test dependencies by the workflow-equivalent default.
The clean Git archive has no installed node_modules. Trivy requests installed pnpm package metadata for package-license collection; this is not a complete installed-package license inventory.
The committed LGPL-3.0-or-later exception remains in force under its documented scope and review trigger.
Image scans enable vulnerability and secret scanners only, without image license or misconfiguration scanning.
Runtime readiness, restart durability, package-manager absence, full validation, browser tests, and hosted CI results are outside this evidence record.

Original scanner logs and archives remain local audit artifacts. This portable record retains their relevant commands, results, identities, and policies without embedding raw findings or private host paths.
